High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5573 of 2023
Applicant :- Salman

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Umair Mahmood
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Umair Mahmood, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 0483 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Seohara, District Bijnor during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his other family members and according to the FIR marriage of applicant was performed with the sister of the informant about four months before and since marriage applicant and his family members tortured his sister for want of dowry and in the intervening night of 28/29.08.2021 due to want of dowry applicant and his family members committed murder of his sister by strangulating her.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant neither demanded any dowry nor he ever tortured the deceased and actually the sister of the informant was not happy with her marriage with the applicant.

He further submits that after marriage applicant was residing in Delhi and he came to Salman vs State Of U.P. on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139391542/
1 know that his wife is having some illicit relationship with somebody else and when applicant on phone scolded her then she committed suicide and subsequently on the basis of wrong facts FIR of the present case was lodged by her brother.

He further submits that from the post mortem report, it appears that cause of death could not be ascertained and Viscera was preserved but counter affidavit filed by the State, it appears that in Viscera Carbamate Insecticide was found and this fact further suggests that actually deceased committed suicide.
He further submits that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 30.08.2021 i.e. for last about one and half years.

5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased died within four months from her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is specific allegation of demand of dowry against applicant, who is husband, therefore, no leniency can be shown in his favour.

He further submits that in paragraph-18 applicant has stated that due to the illicit relationship of the deceased with somebody applicant scolded her, therefore, she committed suicide but this fact further shows that after the death of the deceased, applicant, the husband of the deceased tried to defame her and on this sole ground alone the instant bail application is liable to be dismissed.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Applicant is the husband of the deceased and his marriage was performed with the deceased just four months before and according to viscera report deceased died due to consumption of Carbamate Insecticide poison and as per applicant after marriage he was residing in Delhi and behind him deceased had developed some illicit relationship with somebody else and when he scolded her then she committed suicide.
Therefore, from the averment made in paragraph-18 to the affidavit, it appears that applicant after the death of the deceased did her character assassination.

8. Although, applicant is in jail since 30.08.2021 i.e. for last about one and half years but he is husband of the deceased and his wife died under abnormal circumstances within four months from her marriage, therefore, in my view, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 18.4.2023 AK Pandey  Salman vs State Of U.P. on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139391542/
